_note: v2 hook overrides for la Fontaine des Salutations (B01_fontaine): only where the painted scene differs from the source hook, plus one respelling fix.

fr_a_demain_phrase.hook: "See you tomorrow, Mister Duh-MAN!" (ah duh-MAN) a girl calls to the old gardener as he wheels his barrow home: SEE YOU TOMORROW!
fr_a_demain_phrase.why: The painting shows a girl waving to the gardener, not a snowman at sunset.

fr_a_plus_tard_phrase.hook: A schoolboy waves his blank top-marks paper, an A-PLUS ("ah-PLOO"), and calls "SEE YOU LATER!" while stepping straight into a puddle of TAR ("tar").
fr_a_plus_tard_phrase.why: The paper is painted blank (no text in paintings).

fr_au_revoir_phrase.hook: "Oh, rev... VWAH!" A little girl revs her red pedal car and zooms off through the gate, waving GOODBYE.
fr_au_revoir_phrase.why: The painted car is a child's pedal car.

fr_a_tout_a_l_heure_phrase.hook: The little tugboat in the fountain gives A TOOT ("ah TOO") as it sets off, and a fisher boy waves his fishing A LURE ("ta LUR"): "SEE YOU LATER TODAY!"
fr_a_tout_a_l_heure_phrase.why: The painting shows a toy tugboat in the fountain basin and a fisher boy.

fr_bonne_soiree_phrase.hook: HAVE A NICE EVENING: a waiter carries out a tray of warm buns ("bun") for the evening soirée ("swa-RAY").
fr_bonne_soiree_phrase.why: The painting shows the waiter with his tray of buns.

fr_bonne_nuit_phrase.hook: "Sleep, my bonny wee ("bon-NWEE") bun!": a girl tucks a little BUN into her doll's bed and wishes it GOOD NIGHT.
fr_bonne_nuit_phrase.why: The painting shows a girl tucking a bun into a doll's bed.

fr_bonne_journee_phrase.hook: A hiker with a big BUN under his arm and a walking stick sets off on a day's JOURNEY ("bun zhoor-NAY"): HAVE A NICE DAY!
fr_bonne_journee_phrase.why: The painting shows the bun carried under his arm, with a rucksack and stick.

fr_allo_intj.hook: A lady at the café table picks up the old telephone and answers in a low ("ah-LOH") voice: "HELLO?"
fr_allo_intj.why: The painting shows a young woman on the telephone, not a granny.

fr_hein_intj.hook: A puzzled lady at the café table cups her ear: "HUH? EH? (an?)"
fr_hein_intj.why: The painting shows a woman, not a granny.

fr_comment_vous_appelez_vous_phrase.hook: A shy robot beeps "COME ON, VOO! ZAP-LAY VOO!" ("ko-mon voo za-play VOO") and holds out a blank name badge to the girl: WHAT IS YOUR NAME?
fr_comment_vous_appelez_vous_phrase.why: The painting shows the robot offering one blank badge to a girl.

fr_ca_va_bien_merci_phrase.hook: An old man gives a thumbs-up beside a big BEE ("byan"): "Mercy, I'M WELL, THANK YOU!"
fr_ca_va_bien_merci_phrase.why: The painting shows an old man, not an old lady.

fr_comment_ca_va_phrase.hook: A cheerful pirate parrot perched on a ship's wheel squawks: "COME ON, SAVVY?" ("ko-mon sa-VA"), meaning HOW'S IT GOING?
fr_comment_ca_va_phrase.why: The painting shows the parrot on a ship's wheel, with no crew.

fr_prenom_noun.hook: A mother kneels and tells her toddler his "pre-NAME" ("pray-NOHN"): his FIRST NAME, the one that comes before the surname.
fr_prenom_noun.why: No name tag is painted (no text in paintings).

fr_excusez_moi_phrase.hook: "ehk-skew-zay-MWAH": Like English 'excuse me': a little girl squeezes past a boy, says "EXCUSE ME" and blows a heart-shaped kiss: "MWAH!"

fr_de_rien_phrase.hook: Ryan hands over the cake and the girl says thank you: "De rien!" (duh RYAN), YOU'RE WELCOME.
fr_de_rien_phrase.why: The painting shows the boy Ryan handing the cake over.

fr_remerciement_noun.hook: A girl holds up a THANK-YOU card with a big red heart on it ("ruh-mehr-see-MAHN"): a token of THANKS.
fr_remerciement_noun.why: The card is painted with a heart and no lettering.

fr_je_ne_comprends_pas_phrase.hook: "kohn-PRAHN ... PA": Puzzled Grandpa ("PA") on the park bench stares at his newspaper: "Can't comprehend it!": I DON'T UNDERSTAND.

fr_parlez_vous_anglais_phrase.hook: A boy tourist PARLEYS ("par-LAY") with a kindly policeman, phrasebook open: "DO YOU SPEAK ENGLISH?"
fr_parlez_vous_anglais_phrase.why: The painting shows a boy tourist.

fr_pouvez_vous_repeter_phrase.hook: The painted figurine on the school desk of a mynah bird in its cage cocks its head: "Can you REPEAT ("ray-pay-TAY") that?" CAN YOU SAY IT AGAIN?
fr_pouvez_vous_repeter_phrase.why: Figurines on the desk; respelling avoids 'poo'.

fr_s_il_te_plait_phrase.hook: The painted figurine on the school desk of a seal pup ("SEEL") nudges its ball toward you, begging you to PLAY ("PLEH"): PLEASE!
fr_s_il_te_plait_phrase.why: The zoom shows figurines on the school desk.

fr_s_il_vous_plait_phrase.hook: A little stone SEAL ("SEEL") statue on the school desk bows politely and asks, "Will you play ('PLEH')?": PLEASE.
fr_s_il_vous_plait_phrase.why: The zoom shows figurines on the school desk.

fr_avec_plaisir_phrase.hook: "plai-ZEER": The painted figurine on the school desk of a butler pours tea with a flourish: "WITH PLEASURE!" ("plai-ZEER").

fr_je_vous_en_prie_phrase.hook: "zhuh voo-zahn-PREE": The painted figurine on the school desk of a doorman boy holds his little door open: "After you, PLEASE" ("PREE"): YOU'RE WELCOME.

fr_sante_phrase.hook: The painted figurine on the school desk of Santa ("sahn-TAY") raises a glass of milk: CHEERS, TO YOUR HEALTH!
fr_sante_phrase.why: The zoom shows figurines on the school desk.

fr_si_phrase.hook: The painted figurine on the school desk of a child throws up its arms and shouts "SI!" to contradict: "You didn't? — YES I did!"
fr_si_phrase.why: The zoom shows figurines on the school desk.

fr_chut_intj.hook: A librarian with a book cart says "SHH!" ("shoot") to the raven cawing on her cart: HUSH!
fr_chut_intj.why: The painting shows the raven perched on the cart.

fr_bof_intj.hook: A bored teen slumped on a park bench shrugs: "BOF, so what?"
fr_bof_intj.why: The painting shows a bench, not a sofa.

fr_tchao_intj.hook: A girl waves goodbye from the little garden train: "TCHAO! Ciao! Bye!"
fr_tchao_intj.why: The painting shows a toy garden train.

fr_bis_adj.hook: Children by the bandstand clap and shout "BIS! ("beess") ENCORE!" and the singer sings again.

fr_ouah_intj.hook: A dog stares in amazement at a giant bone: "WAH!" WOW!
fr_ouah_intj.why: Matches the painted dog and bone.

fr_ciao_intj.hook: A girl in a little gondola under the stone bridge waves "BYE!", calling "Ciao!" ("chow").
fr_ciao_intj.why: No friends are painted on the bridge.

fr_ouh_intj.hook: Two children at the puppet booth go "OOH!" in wonder as the puppet dragon pops up, then "BOO!" when it plays the villain.
fr_ouh_intj.why: The painting shows two children at the booth, not a crowd.

fr_hue_intj.hook: The young carter cries "HUE!" ("EW") and his horse sets off, GIDDY-UP!, pulling the little cart.

fr_dia_intj.hook: The carthorse gets an idea ("DYAH"), a light bulb glows above its head, and it turns LEFT just as the carter calls "Dia!": the old command for LEFT.
fr_dia_intj.why: The painting shows a young carter, not a farmer.

fr_hum_intj.hook: "UHM": A wise old bearded man on a tree stump strokes his chin: "HUM... um..." (thinking).

fr_comment_allez_vous_phrase.hook: "ko-mon-ta-lay-VOO": A gentleman tips his top hat to a lady holding a TALLY counter: "COME ON, TALLY, VOO?", the polite HOW ARE YOU?
